name: data-converter
description: Convert CSV, JSON, and Excel data files to another of those formats, and replace personal data in chosen columns with consistent pseudonyms

tools.title: Convert Data File
tools.description: Convert a CSV, JSON, or Excel data file to another of those formats. Requires path, targetFormat, and outputPath. Refuses to overwrite an existing file at outputPath.

tools.title: Pseudonymize Columns
tools.description: Write a copy of a CSV, JSON, or Excel data file in which the named columns hold pseudonyms instead of their values (the same value always gets the same pseudonym, e.g. Name-0001), plus a key file that maps each pseudonym back. The source file is not changed. Use it to share a table without the personal data in it; pass the exact column names.

actions.title: Convert to...
actions.description: Convert this data file to CSV, JSON, or Excel
